title: P18-D cross-objective deliverable handoff — eligible external input sources extend to direct ACTIVE DEPENDS_ON upstream objectives
description: P18-D: cross-objective artifact handoff over the canonical relation substrate. ArtifactHandoffResolver's eligibleSourcesForWorkItemScope() previously authorized only the consumer's own objective (work_item → allocation → objective → same-objective siblings → bound missions → ACCEPTED artifacts). It now builds an authorized-objective set = {consumer objective} ∪ direct ACTIVE DEPENDS_ON upstreams via ObjectiveRelationService.admissionView(objectiveId).upstream — the SAME strict read seam the P18-C scheduler gate uses (corrupt rows wedge loudly; forged/unproven rows can never authorize). Every authorized objective is re-proven: canonical get + business_id equality against the consumer allocation (cross-business authorization impossible). Only DEPENDS_ON authorizes — CONFLICTS/SUPERSEDES never appear in admissionView.upstream; SUSPENDED/REVOKED do not gate or authorize; no transitive traversal (each hop requires its own bilateral-owner edge). All downstream proofs unchanged: per-allocation full authority re-proof, bound-mission provenance, ACCEPTED-artifact + anchored PASS validation, exact artifact identity + CAS byte re-verification, and the single canonical listEligibleExternalInputSources seam consumed by pin/resolve/dispatch re-proofs. Planner-supplied fields stay non-authoritative. Codex-only.
